question: How do I apply for an SCF Build Award — what is the step-by-step application process?

golden.answer:
- Start by **submitting an interest form on communityfund.stellar.org**; eligible applicants are then invited to submit a full proposal. (https://communityfund.stellar.org/awards)
- The full proposal is submitted to a **specific Build track — Open, Integration, or RFP**. Open is for experienced teams pursuing novel or brand-new Stellar use cases, with existing traction or deep Stellar/domain knowledge; Integration and RFP are panel-only. (https://stellar.gitbook.io/scf-handbook/scf-awards/build-award)
- The proposal should include a **technical roadmap, milestone plan, budget breakdown, traction, and team info**; projects typically run **3–6 months**. (https://stellar.gitbook.io/scf-handbook/scf-awards/build-award)
- Review involves a **prescreen plus panel review** (the Open Track Delegate Panel or a Category Delegate Panel), and for the Open Track a **community (NQG) vote**. (https://stellar.gitbook.io/scf-handbook/scf-awards/build-award)
- Awardees must **complete KYC/KYB before receiving milestone-based tranche payments** (up to $150K worth of XLM). (https://stellar.gitbook.io/scf-handbook/scf-awards/build-award)
keyFacts: Applicants start by submitting an interest form on communityfund.stellar.org.
SCF invites eligible applicants to submit a full Open, Integration, or RFP proposal.
Awardees must complete KYC/KYB before receiving (tranche) payments.
avoid: Do NOT invent a generic '/apply' email or claim there is no application (the interest-form → invitation → proposal flow is real).

Do NOT claim stellar.org/enterprise-fund or its application form is the SCF Build application path, and do not attach SCF Build mechanics — the $150K XLM cap, milestone tranches, KYC-before-payment, delegate-panel review, or Open-Track community vote — to the separate Enterprise Fund. The Enterprise Fund's own application is live; the conflation is wrong.
